name: TKP Corporation
summary: TKP Corporation engages in the space revitalization and distribution business in Japan and internationally. The company offers meeting rooms, banquet rooms, rental spaces, and short-term offices; selection of event or exhibit venues, arrangement of equipment, direction of acoustics and lighting, and operation on event days; and employee training, arrangement of accommodation facilities, meals, and transportation. It is also involved in the operation of hotels and training facilities; provision of catering services to business functions, meetings, working lunches, events, parties, and social gatherings; restaurant and café operation; arranging manufacture of box lunches; recruitment reception…
